case_name: Ashok Kumar Meena S/O Shri Badriprasad vs The State Of Rajasthan

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Petitioner - Assistant Agriculture Officer and husband
parties.respondent_defendant: Respondents - The State Of Rajasthan, Director, Deputy Director (Adm.), Assistant Director Agriculture (Extension), and wife (Smt. Priyanka Meena)

facts_of_case: The petitioner is an Assistant Agriculture Officer whose estranged wife demanded half of his salary as per a circular dated 20th September, 2013. The trial court directed the petitioner to deduct half of his salary from March, 2021 onwards.

legal_principles.principle: Any government servant who neglects or refuses to maintain his/her spouse without sufficient and reasonable cause shall be liable for disciplinary action.
legal_principles.held: Sub-rule VI of Rule 4 of the Rajasthan Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1971 specifically provides that any government servant, who without sufficient and reasonable cause, neglects, refuses to maintain his/her spouse, who is unable to maintain himself/herself, shall be liable for disciplinary action.

legal_principles.principle: An enquiry will be conducted by way of disciplinary action and thereafter, direction can be given to make payment of half of the salary.
legal_principles.held: The Circular dated 20th September, 2013 also makes a reference that an enquiry will be conducted by way of disciplinary action and thereafter, direction can be given to make payment of half of the salary.
use_in: cases involving salary deductions for spouse maintenance

outcome.final_order: The impugned order directing the petitioner to deduct half of his salary is set aside and the matter is remanded back to the trial court for fresh consideration.
